snapshots.reason: Issue #2766 extended check_physics_sim_cycle.py Phase 2 from 2 guarded sim files (construction.rs + per_surface_conduction.rs) to ALL src/sim/**/*.rs files. The extension surfaced 84 pre-existing `use crate::physics::` imports across 26 sim files that the pre-#2766 guard never scanned (thermal_model.rs, engine.rs, ventilation.rs, ...). The 84 edges existed all along — this is a one-time coverage-driven re-baselining (sim_to_physics 0 -> 84, total 215 -> 299), NOT a regression: BASELINE_SIM_TO_PHYSICS in check_physics_sim_cycle.py was raised from 0 to 84 in the same commit. The +84 is entirely pre-existing coupling made visible; no new cycle edges were introduced. Downward trend from this new baseline is enforced by R1/R2/R3 going forward.

PR #2793 (issue #2766) was rebased onto develop after merge of #2792 (refactor(sim): decompose ThermalModelData god-struct, issue #2767). The ThermalModelData decomposition relocated several `use crate::physics::` imports across the newly-split sim files without changing the total count (sim_to_physics stayed at 84, total stayed at 299) but altered the edge signature. This snapshot re-captures the post-rebase edge set so R3 (net-flat swap) does not flag the refactor-driven relocation as a regression. No new cycle edges were introduced.
